notes: MLS Assist v1.31 — Study cohort 'Search Athena with MLS Assist' (Mode C). MLS Assist now DRIVES athenaOne itself: it types your CPT/procedure + date range into the procedure/claims/charge search, runs it, and PAGES THROUGH EVERY result page, harvesting each patient (name + DOB + service date/CPT). Every patient still passes the same strict name + DOB verify+import gate before joining the cohort, and pulled patients with a service date are added to the MLS calendar (patient-linked). Read-only in athenaOne — it never clicks Save/Sign. Selectors are tunable (window.__mlsStudyConfig.search); one live tuning pass to your athenaOne search screen is recommended. Reliable typing + the patient-match safety gate are unchanged. Download and reload at chrome://extensions to update.
